### Integration (CCA with SCTransform)


```{r}

# split the object by dataset to integrate
hm.list <- SplitObject(human_mouse, split.by = "sample_origin")

# perform SCTransform normalization
hm.list <- lapply(X = hm.list, FUN = SCTransform)

# select integration features and prep step
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(hm.list)
hm.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(
  hm.list,
  anchor.features = features
)

# downstream integration steps
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  hm.list,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  anchor.features = features,
  reduction = "cca"
)
hm.integrated <- IntegrateData(anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")




```

```{r}
hm.integrated
```

### Clustering

```{r}
human_mouse
```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

hm.integrated <-  hm.integrated |>
  RunPCA(assay = "integrated") |>                                                              
  FindNeighbors() |>
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30) |>
  FindClusters(algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)

DimPlot(hm.integrated, group.by = c("sample_origin","orig.ident"), label = FALSE)
DimPlot(hm.integrated, group.by = c("seurat_clusters"), label = TRUE, shuffle = TRUE)

umapdf <- as.data.frame(hm.integrated[["umap"]]@cell.embeddings) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell")



umapdf <- hm.integrated@meta.data |>
  select(c("sample_origin","species","seurat_clusters")) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  left_join(umapdf, by = "cell") |>
  column_to_rownames("cell")
  
plot_one_over_other(umapdf, "umap_1", "umap_2", "sample_origin", "species", "mouse", "human", "CCA")
plot_one_over_other(umapdf, "umap_1", "umap_2", "species", "species", "mouse", "human", "CCA")
plot_one_over_other(umapdf, "umap_1", "umap_2", "seurat_clusters", "species", "mouse", "human", "CCA")

plot_hist(umapdf, "seurat_clusters","sample_origin", "CCA")
plot_hist(umapdf, "seurat_clusters","species", "CCA")
```
